issue_request: FHIR-16451 was a Published/Persuasive Vocabulary issue asking to change the ValueSet $expand operation text from saying a server will return an OperationOutcome with code too-costly when an expansion is too large to saying the server may return that error.
initial_application: Jira comments identify svn 14717. Later source migration/refactoring preserved that wording in source/valueset/operationdefinition-ValueSet-expand.xml.
additional_context: Vocabulary WG minutes and the Zulip block-vote thread list GF#16451 as Persuasive. ValueSet is active in source/fhir.ini, making the current ValueSet operation source build-scope. The old will-return wording is present only in tools/history/release3 historical artifacts, not current source.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The authoritative current OperationDefinition source already contains the requested MAY wording in both the footer text and operation comment, so editing current source would be redundant and editing historical release snapshots would be wrong.
